book.anima.codex.advanced.name: Soul Workshop
book.anima.codex.advanced.description: Use souls to run machines and restore undead creatures.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.name: Quick Troubleshooting
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.goal: Find a cause and fix when a machine or ritual will not work.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p0.title: No crafting result
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p0.text:
Crafting table: check the displayed recipe. Vanilla bottle and pane recipes remain available alongside glass blowing.\
\
Stamper: view the grid from the open front, with its hinge at the far edge. Power to stamp, unpower to collect.\
\
Blow Mold: check material, fitted mold, nozzle direction and waiting output.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p1.title: No souls or spells
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p1.text:
Extraction: check grown living captive, four connected glass pieces, clear exit and a fresh redstone pulse. Keep green positions and replace the first red one.\
\
Magic: learn the spell, wait for its cooldown, carry the exact fresh souls, and check its target. Well contents and worn workers cannot pay spell costs.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p2.title: No ritual or machine work
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p2.text:
Infusion: verify all nine supports and all eight plinth positions. Preserve clockwise recipe order; offer the right bottle by hand.\
\
Machines: remove pausing redstone, clear outputs and check the nearest well's stock and filters.\
\
Projection: stand on dry ground and protect your body before leaving.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p3.title: Gods and shrines
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p3.text:
Fabricator: use a God Soul and an unused combination of three different item types, with Soul Stone below and four cardinal plinths.\
\
Shrine: put code offerings on three immediately adjacent plates at the same height; use an empty hand to dedicate it. Worship with its sacred item; wait five minutes between offerings. Sneak and use for travel.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p4.title: Priest Rod
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p4.text:
Left-click to choose; the menu closes. Right-click to cast. Stay devout to the rod's god and keep at least one worship to spend. Curse and Blessing each wait 60 seconds; Power waits 120.\
\
Power also needs your god to lead the Pantheon, including a tie. A code identifies the god; its sacred item is what you offer to earn worship.
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p5.title: Deity Hammer
book.anima.codex.advanced.help.p5.text:
Check three adjacent, level plates with a living god's code, open sky and a clear 5×5×8 space above. Leave Peaceful difficulty; the god cannot already be in another battle.\
\
Jump over the Event Horizon's moving edge. Run out of claw circles during hunts. Keep the activating player alive and within the arena. See [Challenge a God](entry://anima:codex/advanced/deity_hammer).
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.name: Workers & Machine Controls
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.goal: Stock a Soul Well and choose which soul kinds machines may use.
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.p0.tex:
A machine takes a worker when it has a job and its current worker cannot pay. Its nearest loaded well must be within 32 blocks.\
\
It prefers its favored soul kind, otherwise the available kind the well holds most of. Keep filters exclude kinds. A worker lasts 20 durability, or 30 if favored.
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.p1.tex:
Each job wears its worker. Smelting and research charge when starting; automation charges for completed jobs. Idle automation spends nothing.\
\
Workers stay in their machines. Breaking a machine destroys its worker. Worn souls cannot return to wells or pay spell costs.
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.p2.tex:
Power a machine with redstone to pause it. Funnels and Stampers instead use redstone to start work. Bone Cage signals open and close its doors.\
\
A comparator reads Soul Well fullness, from 0 when empty to 15 when full. Other soul machines pulse 15 when a job completes. Use this signal to monitor your workshop.
book.anima.codex.advanced.workers.p3.tex:
Check for a valid job, free output space, required tool or supplies, and an unpowered machine. Then check its nearest well, distance and Keep filters.\
\
A nearer empty or paused well prevents fallback to another well. Automation acts as the machine's owner and respects applicable block protection.
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.name: Route Loose Souls
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.goal: Make Soul Relays for crafting or routing loose souls.
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.p0.title: Connect a route
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.p0.text:
Place Soul Relays at most ten blocks apart. Put the final relay close enough that a soul on it is within ten blocks of a Soul Well.\
\
Loose souls follow the connected route toward a well with room for their kind. Relays need no worker, bottle input or manual linking.
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.p1.title: Leave a clear path
book.anima.codex.advanced.relay.p1.text:
Creature-shaped spirits walk to relays; keep their path and the portal reachable. A blocked destination is temporarily avoided. Powering a relay pauses it.\
\
If no well on the route has room, a soul explores relays and waits at the last one. Free space in the well or catch it with a bottle.
book.anima.codex.advanced.soul_placer.go: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.
book.anima.codex.advanced.soul_placer.p0:
Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Ender workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Its working face points away from the surface you click, like placing a log: up, down, or sideways. It works on the adjacent block at that face.
book.anima.codex.advanced.soul_placer.p1: Load blocks into its inputs. It places one in the empty space against its marked working face, costing 2 worker durability. Hoppers can supply blocks. Keep the target space clear.
book.anima.codex.advanced.soul_breaker.g: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.
book.anima.codex.advanced.soul_breaker.p:
Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Doomed workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Its working face points away from the surface you click, like placing a log: up, down, or sideways. It works on the adjacent block at that face.

It breaks the block against its marked working face for 2 worker durability. Put a suitable tool in its Tool slot; enchantments such as Fortune and Silk Touch apply, and the tool wears. Without a tool it harvests only what a bare hand can. It leaves containers, machines and Anima blocks intact.

The screen shows the working face and why the Breaker is waiting. It draws a worker only when a breakable block and a suitable tool are ready. An empty Worker slot can mean there is no job yet.\
\
Sneak while placing a block against the Breaker to avoid opening its GUI. Redstone pauses work. Check that your Soul Well has souls set to Use rather than Keep.
book.anima.codex.advanced.totem_of_harve: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.

Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Benign workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Idols stand two blocks tall. Their facing does not affect their work.

It harvests mature crops and nether wart in a 7×7 area, up to one block above or below its base. It reserves one seed to replant and costs 2 worker durability per crop. Six slots collect the harvest; empty them with a hopper below.
book.anima.codex.advanced.totem_of_gathe: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.

Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Aquatic workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Idols stand two blocks tall. Their facing does not affect their work.
It collects loose items up to four blocks sideways and two vertically into eight slots. It costs 1 worker durability per 16 items; partial batches carry over. Empty its inventory with a hopper below.
book.anima.codex.advanced.totem_of_sheph: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.

Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Predatory workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Idols stand two blocks tall. Their facing does not affect their work.
Put shears in its Tool slot. It shears sheep in a 9×9 area for 4 worker durability each, and wears the shears. Six slots collect wool. Use a hopper below to keep them clear.
book.anima.codex.advanced.totem_of_breed: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.

Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Benign workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Idols stand two blocks tall. Their facing does not affect their work.

Load suitable breeding food. It breeds pairs in a 9×9 area for 10 worker durability per pair. It stops when twelve animals of that kind are nearby. Move offspring out to keep breeding. Hoppers can supply food.
book.anima.codex.advanced.totem_of_fores: Optional: supply this machine from a Soul Well and set up its job.

Place this machine within 32 blocks of a stocked Soul Well. Unhinged workers last longest. It checks for work once per second.\
\
Idols stand two blocks tall. Their facing does not affect their work.

Supply saplings in its six input slots. It finds a trunk within four blocks and fells up to 256 connected logs for 10 worker durability. The tree must have natural leaves; log walls are ignored. It replants a supplied sapling and stores logs in six output slots. Hoppers below empty the outputs.
Use a Wise soul to restore an undead creature in a cage.
Craft a Corporeal Reconstructor, one Bone Cage and eight Soul Stone. Place the Reconstructor at the center of a 5×5 area and the cage directly above it.
Use the preview for the eight stones at the Reconstructor’s height. Extra stones are allowed in unmarked spaces. Keep the cage and center as shown.

Close an undead creature in the cage. Supply a Wise soul in a complete, loaded Soul Well within 32 blocks of the pedestal in the same dimension.\
\
The nearest eligible well is used. Its Wise kind must not be set to Keep, and the well and pedestal must be unpowered; the cage doors must be closed.

After ten seconds, one Wise soul is consumed. The undead becomes a living villager; a zombified piglin becomes a piglin that stays alive in the Overworld.\
\
Equipment and custom name carry over. Babies stay babies. Open the cage to release the result. The restored creature has a soul again.

Opening the cage, breaking the structure, pausing with redstone or losing the Wise soul supply resets work without spending a soul.\
\
Living creatures, spirits and summoned constructs cannot be reconstructed. This ritual needs the separate Soul Well as well as its own eight-stone frame.
Eight Soul Stone, one Reconstructor and a Bone Cage above it. Extra stones in unmarked spaces are allowed.
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.name: Make Ceremonial Attire
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.goal: After infusion, make Spirit Thread, Shadoweave Cloth and a robe.
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.p0.title: Thread, cloth, robe
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.p0.text:
Make Spirit Thread, then Shadoweave Cloth and a Ceremonial Robe.\
\
Wear the robe in your chest slot to use the Altar of Souls. It protects like a leather tunic and accepts chest armor enchantments.
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.p1.title: Keep it repaired
book.anima.codex.advanced.robe.p1.text:
Repair the robe with Shadoweave Cloth at an anvil. Spirit Thread also crafts the Soul Leash item.\
\
The robe is required for altar offerings; Foci spellcasting does not require it.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.name: Offer Souls for Enchantments
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.goal: Wear the robe and trade four souls plus an item for an enchanted book.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p0.t:
Place the two-block-tall Altar of Souls and wear a Ceremonial Robe. Hold a fresh soul bottle, then right-click either half.\
\
An offering takes four souls of that kind from your inventory and Soul Gems, plus one matching item. Empty bottles return. The reward is one enchanted book.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p1.t:
Each soul kind has its own enchantment pool, listed on the following pages. Results and levels are random; one offering in ten gives a curse instead. Lower levels are more common.\
\
Combine matching books at an anvil to raise their level. Other mods can add enchantments to these pools.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p2.t:
Offer 4 Benign souls and one Golden Carrot.\
\
Possible enchantments: Protection, Feather Falling, Fortune.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p3.t:
Offer 4 Predatory souls and one Rabbit Foot.\
\
Possible enchantments: Sharpness, Looting, Sweeping Edge, Power, Piercing, Lunge.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p4.t:
Offer 4 Doomed souls and one Phantom Membrane.\
\
Possible enchantments: Smite, Thorns, Soul Speed, Swift Sneak, Breach.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p5.t:
Offer 4 Unhinged souls and one Breeze Rod.\
\
Possible enchantments: Blast Protection, Knockback, Punch, Bane Of Arthropods, Density, Wind Burst.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p6.t:
Offer 4 Aquatic souls and one Nautilus Shell.\
\
Possible enchantments: Respiration, Aqua Affinity, Depth Strider, Frost Walker, Impaling, Riptide, Loyalty, Channeling, Luck Of The Sea, Lure.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p7.t:
Offer 4 Ender souls and one Ender Eye.\
\
Possible enchantments: Silk Touch, Infinity, Projectile Protection.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p8.t:
Offer 4 Infernal souls and one Ghast Tear.\
\
Possible enchantments: Fire Aspect, Flame, Fire Protection, Multishot, Quick Charge.
book.anima.codex.advanced.offerings.p9.t:
Offer 4 Wise souls and one Emerald.\
\
Possible enchantments: Mending, Efficiency, Unbreaking.
